name: Princess
source:
Princess of a magical land. She is single. She was sealed  20 years ago.

She tried to conquer the magical land using Lamia and others she created from her genes,
But Rei, Yuki, and others prevented her from doing so.

She plans to destroy the power of magical girls, and kill Noriyuki who has the power to completely destroy demons.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/momofero/product/majomama/index.html]official site[/url]]
